What if friction disappeared for five seconds?
First, you'd fall. Walking only works because your shoes grip the ground.
Cars would slide helplessly. Tyres need friction to steer, and brakes need it to stop.
Knots would slip loose, and nails would start sliding out of the walls. Friction is what holds them in place.
Even your clothes would start to come apart. Only friction stops their threads from sliding loose.
And anything on a slope, from rocks to parked cars, would start sliding downhill.
When friction comes back, everything that was sliding would screech to a stop.
What would you grab first? Tell me in the comments.
